subject: How to get standardized posterior estimates in output summary?

messages.author: bd79c1ddcc72ffbf
messages.subject: How to get standardized posterior estimates in output summary?
parts: I know in lavaan, the summary function shows both standardized and unstandardized posterior estimates. Is there a way to get this in blavaan?

messages.author: 82889e926eb5165e
messages.subject: Re: How to get standardized posterior estimates in output summary?
parts:
with the same argument as in lavaan in the summary function



library(blavaan)
library(lavaan)

# The Holzinger and Swineford (1939) example
HS.model <- ' visual  =~ x1 + x2 + x3
              textual =~ x4 + x5 + x6
              speed   =~ x7 + x8 + x9 '

fit <- bcfa(HS.model, data=HolzingerSwineford1939)
summary(fit, standardized=T)
